title: SUPERVISORY COSMEC MANAGER — United States Fleet Forces Command
summary: You will serve as a SUPERVISORY COMSEC MANAGER in the NAVAL COMPUTER AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS MASTER STATION ATLANTIC DEPARTMENT of NCTAMS LANT DET SOUDA BAY, Greece. This position is a DoD Cyber Excepted Service (CES) personnel system position in the Excepted Service under 10 U. $63,795–$87,192 per year
